description: This source file defines the configuration and setup routines for a Mazda Miata VVT engine control unit. It includes hardware pin definitions, engine parameters, fuel and ignition tables, configuration functions for different engine variants, and setup routines to initialize engine and board configurations, including sensor setup, trigger wiring, fuel maps, ignition timing, and auxiliary features.

methods.name: setMazdaMiataNbTpsTps
methods.description: Initializes the TPS acceleration table bins for Mazda Miata NB with predefined RPM and load breakpoints.

methods.name: setMazdaMiataNbInjectorLag
methods.description: Copies injector lag correction values and bins into the engine configuration.

methods.name: setMazdaMiata2003EngineConfiguration
methods.description: Configures engine parameters specific to a 2003 Mazda Miata engine including trigger setup, fuel tables, ignition timing, and auxiliary control parameters.

methods.name: setMazdaMiata2003EngineConfigurationNaFuelRail
methods.description: Extends 2003 engine configuration with additional fuel correction tables and target AFR settings for a na fuel rail setup.

methods.name: setMazdaMiata2003EngineConfigurationBoardTest
methods.description: A variant of the engine setup tailored for testing using a specific wiring configuration and sensor pin setup.
